title: Architect review
description: openspec/changes/<change>/architect-review.json: the review of a change's proposal, specs, design and tasks against principles §I–VII, written after tasks.md.

verdict.description: What the delivery gate reads: approve, or rework while any finding is open.

reviewer.description: Who reviewed: the architect-reviewer subagent, or the planner's self-review.

reasoning.description: One line on why the verdict holds.

classes.description: One entry per finding class, each with the evidence its description names and ok or the finding.

simpler.description: The simpler design considered and why the scenarios reject it.

map.description: Each scenario of the spec deltas and its entry of the scenario → test map.

red.description: Group 1's tests or its `no RED: <reason>` task.

platform.description: Each platform behaviour a design rests on and the observation beside it (reference page, run id or command output); asserted, not observed, is a finding.

replaced.description: Each replaced input or dropped guard and the Design lists beside it.

catcher.description: Each named catcher and the delivery step it reaches in the described case; one the review cannot trace is a finding.

length.description: For each rule or spec sentence the plan adds or edits, its word count and the count of the words its tests assert.

bespoke.description: For each script, check or file the plan adds, the observed problem it closes (issue, PR, run) or `none`.

scenario_coverage.description: Every scenario of the spec deltas no test can prove, with the reason tasks.md carries.
